passages.note: House Third Reading vote tally; Hernandez voted No on a bill requiring documentary proof of citizenship to register.

passages.provision_quote: any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Operative clause requires documentary proof of citizenship to register; matches rung 5's object, which Hernandez's No vote rejected.

rows.reasoning: Hernandez voted No on HB2492 (2022), whose operative clause required that 'any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship... and the county recorder... shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship' -- matching 'Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote.' Her No vote shows opposition to that requirement but does not by itself establish which of the remaining, less restrictive rungs she holds, so the row is direction-only.
